results.answer: Most of your field is below the optimal 6.0‑6.5 range. The Roanoke silt loam (≈33 % of the field) is especially acidic at pH 4.5, while the other soils sit around pH 5.3‑5.5. To bring the whole field into the target range, apply lime. Because the exact lime rate depends on the current pH and soil texture, get a soil‑test‑based recommendation and apply enough lime to raise the low‑pH zones, especially the Roanoke soils. This will improve nutrient availability and help the corn handle any early‑season wet stress from the poorly drained areas.
